thread:
incident-bot: Pager: KV cache error-rate and eviction spike detected for prefix routing layer. SLO error budget approaching. Alert severity: P1. link_to_dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/cache/alerts/2612349001 :rotating_light:
Anya K: I'm on it — taking first touch. Can someone share the heatmap and affected regions?
Mike L: hitting the dashboards now, looks like a sudden rise in miss ratio for prefixes: /v1/prefix/* starting ~2612348800. 90th p99 latency up, CPU on gpu-pool-3 spiking.
Sara P: are we seeing tenant-specific hotkeys or global?
Mike L: preliminary: ~65% of the excess traffic comes from 3 tenants, but there's a global pattern — likely prefetch + a tenant burst causing eviction churn.
Anya K: ok. immediate mitigations: 1) roll rate-limit on suspect tenants 2) reduce prefetch window 3) enable prefix-bypass-for-correctness on a small subset to avoid stale reads. I'll coordinate.
Juan R: pinging billing/CS for top-3 tenants so we can prepare comms.
ops-bot: runbook step: apply tenant_rate_limit -> curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/quotas/apply -d '{\"tenant\":\"TENANT_ID\",\"qps\":50}' (requires ops token)
Mike L: I'm going to snapshot current prefix-eviction metrics and throttle prefetch. Running: 
```
kubectl -n inference exec -it prefetch-ctrl -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS localhost:8080/admin/config | jq .prefetch_window"
# reduce from 120s -> 20s
kubectl -n inference exec prefetch-ctrl -- /bin/sh -c "curl -XPOST localhost:8080/admin/config -d '{\"prefetch_window\":20}'"
```
Sara P: I'm patching a safe feature-flag to bypass prefix cache only for reads when correctness-check enabled. This will increase load but avoid incorrect responses. Preparing canary.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued by Sara P for feature-toggle: prefix_bypass_read_correctness -> canary to 5% (deploy-id: d-7891).
Anya K: Mike, please run a quick test to ensure bypass path doesn't catastrophically increase backend QPS.
Mike L: running synthetic against canary: 50 req/s for 1 min -> backend qps up ~12%, latency stable. No errors seen in canary pods.
Juan R: drafted customer note for tenant owners: "We detected anomalous traffic causing cache eviction and elevated latency. We applied temporary rate limits and reduced prefetch; may see slightly higher backend latency while we stabilize. We'll update within 30m." Want to send after we confirm mitigations.
Anya K: go ahead on notifying owners, mark as "investigating" in the incident tracker.
ops-bot: Applied tenant rate limits: TENANT_A -> 40qps, TENANT_B -> 30qps, TENANT_C -> 20qps. (op: limit-apply-2612349001)
Mike L: after rate limits + prefetch reduction, eviction rate dropped ~70% in last 60s, prefix miss ratio trending down. Good signal.
Sara P: increasing prefix bypass rollout to 20% for reads to cover more requests and catch any correctness issues.
deploy-bot: feature-toggle updated: prefix_bypass_read_correctness -> 20% (deploy-id: d-7891-b)
Anya K: monitoring customer-facing errors and model outputs for correctness regressions — set alarms on mismatched outputs and 5xx.
Mike L: quick log snippet from prefix-router: 
```
[2612349030] WARN prefix-router eviction_rate=0.82 -> applying emergency backpressure
[2612349041] INFO prefetch ctrl set window=20
[2612349052] INFO tenant-limit applied TENANT_A qps=40
```
